{{Top|leg}}
'''Task Group Destruction''' was a [[Flotilla/Legends|flotilla]] that was assembled by the [[Cularin Militia|Cularin Armed Forces]], a division of the [[Republic Military/Legends|Republic Military]], during the [[Time/Legends|time]] of the [[Clone Wars/Legends|Clone Wars]]. The unit included the [[Light cruiser/Legends|light cruiser]] [[Vigilance (light cruiser)|''Vigilance'']], some [[G61 Delta Wing]]s, two support vessels, some [[clone marine]]s and the [[Heroes of Cularin]], and was commanded by [[Captain/Legends|Captain]] [[Suubrin]]. It was dispatched to a [[Unidentified system (abandoned Separatist base)|deserted system]] in about [[19 BBY/Legends|19 BBY]], to carry out a [[Destruction|raid]] on an [[abandoned Separatist base]].
